title: fix(ui): a row action's `disabled` predicate greys its inline row button, and row surfaces give its `disabledReason`
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XPHSGeRPukMUiLLqB8EtPVj)_

Fixes #33215

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no authorable key, value or meaning changes; `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` (section "Saying why: `disabledReason`") already describes the behaviour this PR delivers on the row surfaces

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表行上的动作按钮现在照记录头部的规则读 `disabled`。表格行内的主按钮(`variant: 'primary'`,对象列表与放大后的相关列表都画它)以前完全不读 `disabled`,现在为真时置灰、点不动,谓词出错也置灰(fail-closed);置灰时带上动作的 `disabledReason`(无声明则用通用句「Not available for this record」),作为 `aria-describedby` 和悬停提示。各行「⋮」菜单项本来就会置灰,现在同样在标签下显示原因。
- 为什么改:`ActionSchema.disabled` 的契约是「为真时显示但拒绝」,记录头部守约,相关列表的行按钮不守约(卡上下游实测)。服务端照样拒绝,所以这是展示缺陷,不是越权。
- 风险与回滚:只改渲染;没有东西不再渲染,但行内主按钮在 `disabled` 谓词为真或出错时从此置灰、不可点(记录头部的按钮本来如此);`@object-ui/components` 新增导出既有的 disabled-reason 辅助(导出纯增,Clause-② yes (widening)),供 plugin-grid 复用同一份。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx` 的 `RowActionInlineButton`(本卡的根因);`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` 的 `DataTableRowActionItem`;`ui/packages/components/src/index.ts` 的新导出。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/relatedListRowActionDisabled-33215.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.rowActionDisabled-33215.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件 8 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Root cause, measured on `origin/main` fdb76fb8.** A `record_related` action reaches a parent's related list through `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` (`deriveActions` keeps every key, `disabled` and `disabledReason` included) and is drawn on two faces:

| Related-list face | Row surface | `disabled` before | `disabledReason` before |
|---|---|---|---|
| Card (default): `data-table` | "⋮" item `DataTableRowActionItem` | honoured, fail-closed | not attached |
| Enlarged tab: `object-grid` | inline button `RowActionInlineButton` (`variant: 'primary'`) | **ignored**: the button stayed enabled and dispatched | not attached |
| Enlarged tab: `object-grid` | "⋮" item `RowActionMenuItem` | honoured, fail-closed | not attached |

The inline button is the "row button" the card's DOM probe read as `disabled=false`. It is also the object list's inline row button (same `RowActionMenu`), so the main list row had the same defect; this PR fixes it there too.

**The fix.**

- `RowActionInlineButton` (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`) evaluates `disabled` exactly as the "⋮" item beside it does: `useRowPredicate(def.disabled, row, { fallback: true, warnOnError: true, fields })`, counted only when `hasDeclaredPredicate` says a gate is declared. That is `evalRowPredicate`, the entry the record header's `evalHeaderPredicate` calls, with the header's fail direction for this key (`fallback: true`, a faulting predicate disables). No second evaluator.
- A disabled inline button carries the reason the way the record header's button does: `aria-describedby` on the button pointing at an `sr-only` copy, inside a focusable tooltip trigger (`DisabledReasonTrigger`).
- The "⋮" items of both menus (`DataTableRowActionItem`, `RowActionMenuItem`) show the reason as a second line under the label and name it as the item's description (`aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby`), the shape `action:menu` already uses.
- The reason text comes from `useDisabledReason`: the action's declared `disabledReason` (string or inline locale map; the related-list path hands it already localized by `localizeActionTexts`), else `actions.notAvailableForRecord`. Only the DECLARED `disabled` verdict earns it.
- `@object-ui/components` exports that helper (`useDisabledReason`, `DisabledReasonTrigger`, `DisabledReasonMenuLabel`, `menuItemReasonAria`, type `DisabledReason`) so plugin-grid reads the one the `action:*` renderers and `data-table` read, instead of keeping a copy. This is the `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; the claim's starting value was `no`, so the seat amends it. Nothing stops rendering; the inline row button is now disabled where its `disabled` predicate is true or faults, as the record header's button already is.

No `packages/spec` edit: `ActionSchema.disabled` / `disabledReason` are unchanged and govern.

**Other row-action surfaces checked** (order: "every other row-action surface that renders the same action schema"):

- Row context menu (`RowContextMenu`, data-table's own context menu): renders the same item components, so it is covered by the item fix.
- Phone card rows (`ObjectGrid` with `maxInlineActions={0}`): menu items only, same `RowActionMenuItem`.
- `plugin-list`'s `ListView` and `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` only forward `rowActionDefs` to the grid or the data-table above. Kanban draws no `list_item` / `record_related` row actions (no `rowActionDefs` reader in `plugin-kanban`).
- Built-in Edit / Delete (`disabledWhen`): a different key with its documented fail-soft posture; untouched.

## Tests

Two new rendered pins, each driving the real chain through user events (no handler called directly):

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/relatedListRowActionDisabled-33215.test.tsx`: `RelatedList` in `RelatedListEnlargedContext` → real `object-grid` → `RowActionMenu`. Inline primary button: disabled with reason attached on the row whose record makes `disabled` true, and a click dispatches nothing; CONTROL enabled with no reason and a click dispatches the row; a faulting predicate disables it. "⋮" item: reason attached on the true row; CONTROL none.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.rowActionDisabled-33215.test.tsx`: `RelatedList` → real `data-table` → the row's "⋮" opened by click. Disabled item with reason on the true row, click dispatches nothing; CONTROL enabled with no reason, click dispatches the row; faulting predicate greys it and gives the reason.

**Ablation** on head `de6d05f9` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, one leg per changed behaviour (the ui vitest config aliases `@object-ui/*` to source, so no build sits between mutation and run). Each leg: anchor 1 to 0, mutation landed, then restored with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | inline button `disabled={isDisabled}` → `disabled={false && isDisabled}` | inline "disabled with its reason" and inline "faults (fail-closed)": 2 of 8 |
| A2 | inline button `aria-describedby={disabledReason?.id}` → `undefined && …` | inline "disabled with its reason": 1 of 8 |
| A3 | grid "⋮" item `menuItemReasonAria(disabledReason)` → `menuItemReasonAria(undefined)` | grid "⋮" "describes it with the reason": 1 of 8 |
| A4 | data-table "⋮" item `menuItemReasonAria(disabledReason)` → `menuItemReasonAria(undefined)` | data-table "describes it with the reason" and "faults … gives the reason": 2 of 8 |

The CONTROL cases stayed green on every leg. A1 is the defect as shipped on `origin/main`: the inline button with no `disabled` binding.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured face of the card's symptom.** The downstream app and its PR are outside this session's reach, so which face the probe hit is inferred: only the inline primary button rendered a button element whose `disabled` was false on a true predicate; both "⋮" items already greyed. The card's other half (reason attached) was missing on all three surfaces and is fixed on all three.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` already says the reason shows "as the button's hover title and its accessible description (a menu item shows it under its label)"; the row surfaces now match it. No doc edit.
- **Copies of the reason wrapper left in place.** `containers.tsx` (`page:header`), app-shell's `DeclaredActionsBar` and plugin-detail's `record:quick_actions` keep their own wrappers (the helper's header says so). Converging them on the new export is a refactor outside this card. class: observation · reach: none · carrier: none.
- **Sibling card.** #33219 (PR #33305) changes list-row navigation in `plugin-list` / `plugin-grid`; this PR touches only the action-rendering region of `RowActionMenu.tsx`.
